meta.definition: Net inflow is what investors put into open-ended funds of a category in the month minus what they took out, as printed in AMFI's monthly report. Dividing by the category's assets a month earlier makes a small category's rush comparable with a big one's. Shaded months are small-cap inflow waves: three months of small-cap inflow, as a share of assets, larger than four out of five earlier three-month stretches. Reports before April 2019 print only broad lines, so most equity categories start then.
meta.technical: AMFI monthly reports 2009-02 onward, open-ended schemes; months whose category rows do not add up to AMFI's printed sub-totals within Rs 1 crore are left blank; wave bar = expanding 80th percentile of earlier three-month sums, needing 24 of them.
